label: MIRROR_1: the global mirror as spatial reflection P, a map on worlds
definition: MIRROR_1. SpatialReflection W is a structure with one field image : W → W. image v is the world v with every spatial arrangement reflected (parity P) and nothing else changed: charges, matter/antimatter and the direction of time are kept. It is an explicitly identified PRIMITIVE of TruthCore.Modal.MirrorCollapse; Lean fixes only its type, and nothing in Lean says which features the map preserves.
note: Stipulated for #2145 lane M as the sense distinguished from MIRROR_2 (DEF 7147bcb5) in the mirror disambiguation dec35f6f. Physics background, navigation only and no attributed claim: the weak interaction is not invariant under P (Wu et al. 1957; V−A coupling). So on dispositional essentialism the P-image of the actual world violates the law-grounding natures of creaturely kinds, and preservation of essential truths by P is doubtful (option 1 at a creature). No registered argument uses this sense; the registered mirror argument (contingentFromChiralMirror) uses MIRROR_2. The generic premises EssentialTruthsPreservedByMirrorAt, HandednessReversedAt and ChiralAtMirrorImageAt and the fork certificate range over any world map (DEF 3fc924f3) and so cover both senses.

formal_gap.meaning: image maps each world to its spatial (P) mirror image; a model supplies the map.
examples: A world containing one left hand and nothing else; its P-image contains one right hand of the same matter.
exclusions: CPT conjugation, which also conjugates charge and reverses time (MIRROR_2).
A translation or rotation, which preserves handedness.
open_obligations: Whether the P-image of the actual world violates a creaturely nature (dispositional essentialism about the weak interaction says yes).
